facts.fact: 2010 年 11 月雪夜 David 飞抵 DTW（底特律），兑现 Erin「make it real」的承诺
facts.anchor: David touched down at DTW on a snowy November night.

facts.fact: Erin 失踪逾一年、守夜周年；David 是 head suspect、全网定罪但证据 circumstantial 无法逮捕
facts.anchor: The evidence had all been too circumstantial for an actual arrest to be made.

facts.fact: 毕业典礼被喊 Murderer；Jim Davis 消失（O.J. 都有更可信替罪羊）
facts.anchor: O. J. Simpson had a more believable patsy.

facts.fact: PAA 广播在 Erin 消失时停止（只为 Erin 的眼）；David 仍坚持监控
2010 社交媒体兴起：David 建 Facebook/Twitter/Tumblr/私人论坛、封禁 troll、结交第一批追随者（含 Emily）
facts.anchor: A cause not so much to live for, but to provide sufficient cover for withdrawal.

facts.fact: 广播重现：half sleep 时 tiny zap in brain=屏幕 flicker，Erin 声音回归
facts.anchor: And then, finally, he heard her.

facts.fact: Erin 第二条 transmission 给出 Chloe Edmonds 名字+地址（Forty-four Lake Drive Place, Allen Park, Michigan）
facts.anchor: “…Chloe Edmonds,” she said. “Forty-four Lake Drive Place in Allen Park, Michigan.

facts.fact: Chloe 的 Pink Eye TV 口述 Sunday's Best（1959-1965 CBS 真剧），她坚称没听过
facts.anchor: Sunday’s Best was an actual detective show that had aired on the CBS Network between 1959 and 1965.

facts.fact: 机场 diner：Chloe 解释 conjunctivitis/以丑名命名频道/扮演硬汉侦探是 escape
facts.anchor: Putting myself in the shoes of a hard-boiled detective who can solve any mystery.

facts.fact: David 摊牌+递 Erin 毕业照求救；停车场 Chloe 吻他、他躲开
一周后 Chloe 留言自称创造了所有侦探剧；两天后失踪新闻；David 归档
facts.anchor: I’m pretty sure I made them all

facts.fact: Chloe 不是那个人（power 不够带 Erin 回来）；His first that felt easy
